# ===================
# HU	density g/cm3

# (Nov 8 2026) Same points as matRad/hluts/matRad_default.hlut (HU -> relative stopping
# power used by the matRad pencil beam), with water as the only material (see
# HU_Material_Conversion.txt), so MCsquare's stopping power = this "density" x water.
# Purpose: MCsquare and the pencil beam use the SAME HU -> stopping-power conversion,
# so MC - PB differences are transport physics, not calibration. Replace both with the
# UHN (RayStation) CT calibration when it is available.
-1024   0.001
-999    0.001
-90     0.95
-45     0.99
0       1
100     1.095
350     1.199
3000    2.505
3071    2.540
